policy.instruction: Publish only the six payload paths listed in include plus this manifest. Exclude every other current or future path.
policy.precedence: Exact include and control_file paths are evaluated first; exclude rules apply only to every other path.

include.provenance: locally authored normalized request ledger; no retrieved content
locally authored query and citation summary; no paper text

payload_set_hash_definition: SHA-256 of the six include records serialized in listed order as: lowercase_sha256, two spaces, relative_path, newline

control_file.sha256: reported out-of-band after freeze because a manifest cannot contain its own cryptographic hash

exclude.reason: raw third-party archive, event, index-response, and repository-metadata bytes
raw GitHub API responses, mirror text, and immutable-object probe bodies
Paperclip tool output and cached paper text; provenance is normalized separately
raw third-party package and registry responses, including unrelated-party metadata
recovered third-party source, coordinate candidates, executable wrapper, verifier copy, and local controller state
raw Exa, Sourcegraph, and grep.app responses plus cached third-party page text
superseded internal ledger with local evidence-path references
superseded internal note referring to excluded local recovered source
internal receipt contains a host-absolute path and replay implementation details
internal receipt superseded by publication/README.md and publication/RECOVERY_RESULT.json
internal integrity index enumerates excluded third-party evidence
catch-all: every path not exactly listed in include or control_file is excluded

audits.portable_path_scan: pass: no host-absolute, file URI, parent-relative, or Windows drive paths in included payloads
audits.secret_scan: pass: no credential markers, API keys, private-key blocks, authorization headers, or bearer tokens
audits.static_content_scan: pass: included payloads are non-executable Markdown, JSON, and gitignore text; no symlinks or executable mode bits
audits.third_party_payload_scan: pass: no cached code, coordinates, page text, paper text, verifier text, API response, archive, package, or binary payload is included
audits.license_boundary: pass: Apache-2.0 is reported only as upstream metadata; absence of original LICENSE/NOTICE is explicit
